title: XML/library behavior gadget
description: A gadget is one small, reproducible behavior of a surface site under weird input — e.g. 'this xpath id() lookup returns the first match on duplicate IDs'.

impacts.description: Optional surface.jsonl site id(s) this gadget affects.

updatedAt.description: When this record was last updated

status.description: Gadgets start in a 'conjectured' state and then progress to confirmed or refuted

statusReason.description: When either 'confirmed', 'refuted', or 'duplicate' this should describe why they're in this state

path.description: Path to the artifact. Either a file or directory
